description:
Breast Cancer Screening Camp
Rotary Club of Manor Highway organized a Breast Cancer Screening Camp to promote early detection of breast cancer. The camp received an overwhelming response from women in the community, with a total of 55 women undergoing breast cancer screening.
The initiative was widely appreciated by everyone for Rotary's valuable contribution to society and its continued efforts to promote community health and well-being.
Rotary Club of Manor Highway continues to make a positive difference in society through its dedicated community service initiatives.
